subject: Intro demo request — Brightline (security + IT required)
messages:
From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@brightline.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 3 Nov 2028 09:15:00 -0500
Subject: Interested in a walkthrough of Redwood Inference (we need IT there)

Hi Grace,

We just signed up for the self-serve trial and I’m the PM running the evaluation for Brightline Health. We want a quick walkthrough of the product and a discussion about our security posture — our InfoSec lead (security@brightline.com) and our infra engineer Marta Ruiz will join.

Ideal timing: next week (Nov 7–9) afternoons Eastern. If you can include someone from product/solutions who can speak to IT/network requirements and to SE for the technical deep dive, that’d be awesome.

A few questions up front:
- Do you have a short agenda we can share with InfoSec?
- Any docs on network requirements (eg firewall rules, egress endpoints)?

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Ethan Cole
Product Manager, Brightline Health
ethan.cole@brightline.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@brightline.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 3 Nov 2028 10:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Interested in a walkthrough of Redwood Inference (we need IT there)

Hi Ethan — great to meet you and congrats on getting started with the trial. I can own scheduling.

Short answers: yes — I’ll attach a 20–30 minute agenda geared for InfoSec + a separate 30–45 minute technical deep-dive with an SE.

Proposed slots (all ET):
- Tue Nov 7, 3:00–3:45 PM ET (overview + Q&A)
- Wed Nov 8, 4:00–5:00 PM ET (deep-dive with SE)
- Thu Nov 9, 2:00–3:00 PM ET (alternate deep-dive)

If you need mornings PT-friendly, we can offer: Wed Nov 8, 9:00–9:45 AM PT (which is 12:00–12:45 PM ET).

Who from your side will take the 1) InfoSec slot and 2) SE deep-dive? I’ll loop in our AE and SE once you confirm preferred times.

Attaching: brightline-demo-agenda.pdf (draft) — I’ll update after you confirm attendees.

Thanks,
Grace
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai

From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@brightline.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@brightline.com>, security@brightline.com
Date: Fri, 3 Nov 2028 11:20:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Interested in a walkthrough of Redwood Inference (we need IT there)

Thanks Grace — attaching the names:
- InfoSec: security@brightline.com (this reaches our lead Raj Patel)
- Infra/Cloud: Marta Ruiz (marta.ruiz@brightline.com)

Preferred: Tue Nov 7 for the overview at 3:00 PM ET, and Wed Nov 8 for the deep-dive at 4:00 PM ET. Can you confirm both and include AE + SE?

Also, Raj asked for a brief list of required outbound endpoints and whether Redwood supports IP allowlisting for Dedicated/private deployments. He’d also like to know if there’s a short checklist we can run prior to the deep-dive (VPN access or test dataset).

Appreciate it — Ethan

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@brightline.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 3 Nov 2028 14:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Interested in a walkthrough of Redwood Inference (we need IT there)

Hi Ethan — Connor here, I’m the AE on this. Thanks for the clarity on attendees and timing — both slots work for us. I’ll be on the overview and will hand to Soojin for the deep-dive.

Quick answers to Raj’s questions:
- Outbound endpoints: our hosted API uses a short list of egress domains (api.redwood.ai, telemetry.redwood.ai). I’ll share a one-pager with precise FQDNs and IP ranges for Dedicated options (we can provide static IPs / allowlist for Dedicated).
- Checklist before deep-dive: (1) list of internal egress/egress blockers, (2) sample prompt or dataset you’d like to test, (3) account or test token access for SE to reproduce any network blocks.

I’ve proposed calendar invites and included a stub rr-demo-times.ics (Grace will send official invites). Can Soojin confirm availability for Wed Nov 8 4:00 PM ET?

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@brightline.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 3 Nov 2028 16:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Interested in a walkthrough of Redwood Inference (we need IT there)

Hi all — Soojin here (SE). Wed Nov 8 4:00 PM ET works for me, but I’ll need either:
- A short test token with the trial account so I can exercise the runtime during the call, or
- A sandbox recording/trace of a failing request if you can reproduce the network block beforehand.

On network requirements: I’ll bring a concise slide that covers ports, FQDNs, and allowlist options. For Dedicated/private deployments we can map to customer-controlled egress and provide IPs. If your security team wants we can run a brief pre-call whiteboard for architecture.

I’ll draft the tech deep-dive agenda and share it to the Drive link above.

Thanks — Soojin

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@brightline.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@brightline.com>, security@brightline.com
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 4 Nov 2028 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: Redwood overview Tue Nov 7 3:00 PM ET + SE deep-dive Wed Nov 8 4:00 PM ET

Hi Ethan/Marta/Raj — confirmed on our side:
- Overview (30 min): Tue Nov 7, 3:00–3:30 PM ET — Connor + Grace (calendar invite attached).
- Technical deep-dive (45 min): Wed Nov 8, 4:00–4:45 PM ET — Connor + Soojin (agenda attached).

Attachments: brightline-demo-agenda.pdf, rr-demo-times.ics
Pre-call checklist for Raj:
- Please confirm whether Brightline prefers IP allowlisting (Dedicated) or we should share FQDNs only for hosted.
- If possible, create a trial API key for us to use during the deep-dive (label: brightline-deep-dive).
- Any internal firewall/proxy logs that show blocked calls — Soojin can triage during the call.

If anything changes I’ll update the invites. Thanks everyone — looking forward to it.

Warmly,
Grace
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
